input.subject: Dropped class, charge, and portal access all at once
input.original_message: Hi, I have a few things going on and I'm not sure who to ask. First, I dropped my statistics class in week three because of a scheduling conflict with my new job, and I still see the full tuition charge on my account. I thought dropping in week three got me at least part of the money back. Second, ever since I dropped it, the student portal keeps kicking me back to the login screen with an error code and I can't get into Canvas to check my other grades, so I also need my official transcript request to go through before a scholarship deadline on Friday. Finally, could you tell me what software I can install for free on my own laptop, because the lab closes at 9pm and I do most of my work after that? Sorry for the long message, I just wanted to get everything into one email.

classification.reasoning: The message mentions several issues, but the first and most specific concern is the full tuition charge after dropping a class and a possible refund, which is a billing matter. The portal/login error is a significant competing issue, so confidence is moderate.

matches.question: What is the refund policy if I drop a class?
matches.answer: A 100% refund applies through the end of the second week of the term, 50% through the fourth week, and no refund after that. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 10 business days. Dropping after the refund window still removes the charge only if the withdrawal is an approved medical or administrative withdrawal.

matches.question: What software can students install for free?
matches.answer: Students get Microsoft 365, the JetBrains suite, GitHub Student Developer Pack, and VMware through software.codis.edu. Log in with your campus account and download from the Student Software page. Adobe Creative Cloud is available only in the open labs, not for personal machines.

matches.question: How do I request an official transcript?
matches.answer: Order official transcripts through the National Student Clearinghouse link in the portal under Records > Transcripts. Electronic transcripts are $8 and usually arrive within one business day; paper transcripts are $12 and take 5 to 7 business days. Unofficial transcripts are free and instant from the same page.
